summary: You produced a strong, concise mission design that meets all requirements. STK and hand calculations support launch, orbit, coverage, downlink and EOL. Your Introduction and Conclusion are clear and well referenced. Main improvements: strengthen the revisit calculation, add an X-band link budget, address Vega C/rideshare and ground-station assumptions, and polish bibliography formatting.
next_steps: In §2.3/Table 3, replace or support the track-spacing/roll-width revisit estimate with an STK coverage/revisit analysis, stating assumptions and reporting revisit statistics.
In §2.4/Table 6, add an X-band link budget (EIRP, path loss, G/T, modulation/coding, margin) to verify the 50 Mbit/s downlink and 34 min usable contact.

In §2.2–2.4, add a risk/evidence note for the unflown Vega C baseline and rideshare dispersion without propulsion, and provide evidence or mitigation for assuming S/X-band at Mount Pleasant; also standardise bibliography entries.

criteria.C1: Your Introduction clearly states the GBR imaging mission, direct-detection rationale, single-spacecraft choice, AIMS operator and customers, with references. This is Accomplished. To secure the top of the band, tighten the link between customer needs and the 5 m visible requirement and ensure every rationale claim has a specific citation.
criteria.C2: Your §2.2–2.5 and Appendix A give strong evidence for launch, orbit, coverage, communications, manoeuvres and EOL. To strengthen within Accomplished, add an STK coverage/revisit analysis for Table 3, an X-band link budget for Table 6’s 50 Mbit/s and 34 min contact, and evidence/risk treatment for Vega C unflown status, rideshare dispersion without propulsion, and Mount Pleasant S/X-band capability.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion is specific and evidence-based: it restates one 50 kg satellite meeting the need and candidly lists four limitations. This is Accomplished. To reach the top of the band, tie each limitation to a concrete risk or next design step and avoid introducing any new material not already supported in the main body.
criteria.C4: Your report has a clear engineering structure, concise Executive Summary, labelled figures/tables and matching citations. At 8/10 in Accomplished, the main gap is bibliography quality: several entries are incomplete or weakly formatted. To move toward the top of the band, standardise all references and check every in-text citation matches the list exactly.
